conventions.units: Pixels in the OUTPUT frame, origin top-left. Times in seconds from item start (30 fps; 1 frame = 0.0333 s). L01 uses CANVAS coordinates (3240x1440) where stated, otherwise tile-local.
conventions.crop: Fractions of the SOURCE image {x,y,w,h} (0..1, origin top-left). The crop rect already has the output aspect ratio; scale it to fill the frame. Never stretch.
conventions.kenburns: Linear interpolation of the crop rect from `from` to `to` over the scene duration with ease 'inOutSine' unless stated.
conventions.text_box: x,y = top-left of the text box; w = max width (wrap inside); align inside the box. `anchor: bottom` means y is the BOTTOM edge of the box (box grows upwards).
conventions.stack: Elements in a `stack` are laid out top-to-bottom (or bottom-up when anchor=bottom) with `gap` px between boxes.
conventions.autofit: If text exceeds max_lines at `size`, reduce size in 2 px steps down to `min_size`. If it still does not fit, STOP and report — do not shorten copy.
conventions.strings: Every `text` value is final copy (verbatim from 03-copy.json or content/i18n.ts). Do not retype — copy-paste. Armenian punctuation ։ ՝ « » ՞ must be preserved.
conventions.rendering: Recommended: render text/graphic layers with HTML+CSS in headless Chromium (exact font stacks below, font-feature-settings normal, -webkit-font-smoothing antialiased) to transparent PNG, then composite with ffmpeg. Do not use editor auto-captions or system fonts.
conventions.placeholders: Text containing [..._ճշտել] must NOT be published. Producer renders a draft with the placeholder visible in red #ff4d4d for review; the final render requires the resolved value from the caller.
conventions.overlay_linear_stops: type 'linear_stops': vertical gradient of `color`; `stops` = [[y_px, alpha], ...] sorted by y, alpha interpolated linearly between stops, constant before the first and after the last stop.
conventions.letter_spacing_centering: Centred text with letter-spacing: add padding-left equal to the letter-spacing (CSS adds tracking after the last glyph) so the visible glyphs are optically centred.
conventions.default_texts: This spec uses the DEFAULT (undated) copy everywhere: no '15.11 · 20:00' on L02, L03 s6 = «Շուտով՝ մեր կայքը». Dated variants in 03-copy.md are NOT rendered.
conventions.verbatim: All `text` values are copied programmatically from 03-copy.json (slides[].title/body, scenes[].text) except: eyebrow URLs on L04 (factual page addresses) and site-native strings captured from the site itself.

capture.what: The site's own Splash component (components/Splash.tsx + .splash rules in app/globals.css), frame-stepped in headless Chromium. NO screen recording, NO upscaling.
capture.server: local production build (see site_capture), URL http://localhost:3123/

context.note: Output frames are exactly 1080x1920. reducedMotion MUST be no-preference (globals.css hides .splash under reduce).

capture.init_script: localStorage.setItem('garon-lang','hy'); const st=window.setTimeout; window.setTimeout=function(f,d,...a){ if(d===3200||d===250) return 0; return st.call(window,f,d,...a); };  // freezes the 3.2 s unmount timer: splash never unmounts
after_load: addStyleTag: html,body{background:#0c0d0e!important;overflow:hidden!important} body>:not(.splash){visibility:hidden!important}  // page behind the splash is hidden, so splashLift reveals plain #0c0d0e (home hero is a stock/AI image and must not appear)
await document.fonts.ready; wait until .splashLogo img complete
capture.per_frame: f = 0..269, t = f/30. Set every animation's currentTime (ms) and the .splash `scale` CSS property (independent transform property, composes with splashLift's transform) per the table below, then page.screenshot() → frames/L02_%03d.png (1080x1920).

frame_table.note: splash fully lifted → plain #0c0d0e; capture once and reuse as end-card base.

capture.zoom_curve: scale = 1 + 0.03*easeInOutSine((t-2.2)/2.4) for 2.2 ≤ t ≤ 4.6; transform-origin 50% 50% (default). In-browser (vector-sharp), not ffmpeg scale.

measured_layout_px.note: x,y,w,h at scale 1.0, measured on the local build 2026-11-10. Splash bg #080909. Counter reaches 100% at 2.1 s; tag finishes fading in at 2.4 s.

capture.timing_source: globals.css: splashDraw 1.1 s (delays .05–.9 s), logoBuild .85–1.95 s, fadeUp corner 1.5–2.2 s, tag 1.7–2.4 s, splashCount 0–2.1 s, splashLift .9 s @ 2.3 s cubic-bezier(.76,0,.24,1).
capture.fallback: If frame stepping fails: real phone screen recording of a page refresh (4K not available → record at device max, crop status bar, scale to 1080x1920). Mark the result as fallback in the manifest.

L02.overlay_text_note: Hooks sit above the drawing (villa top y≈478; at scale 1.03 ≈ 465): box y 300..~395, inside safe area. Single line each, no shadow needed on #080909 (keep style shadow). Cut between hooks = out-fade 4f of the old + in-fade 4f of the new, overlapping on the boundary frame. Hook 3 fades out f 134–137 (before the lift).

end_card.base: captured frame with splash fully lifted (#0c0d0e)

layers.note: Matches the splash's own column lines exactly (60 CSS px × 3; 1 CSS px = 3 px; .07 × opacity .5), so the lines continue seamlessly as the curtain lifts. Layer sits UNDER the captured frames during 4.6–5.5 (composite frames with the lifted area showing these lines: render the vlines into the page via the injected style `html{background:#0c0d0e linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(201,169,106,.035) 1px,transparent 1px) 0 0/60px 100%}` — preferred, then they are in the capture).
Copy is «Լողավազաններ · Տներ · Վերանորոգում»; rendered in capitals = same as L01a label (Armenian uppercase via CSS text-transform is fine).
